note: College A+ paper track: bet EVERY offer the college grade rates A+ (EV >= 4% vs Pinnacle's no-vig line at the same moment, key-number pricing, cfbpred.dist) at your books (my_books.json), spreads, totals and moneylines priced -200..+200, one bet per game per market at the first A+ snapshot, 7 days to 60 min before kickoff, flat 1 unit. Evidence (output/research/cfb/round2.md, 'your 3 books EV>=4%' rules, 2021-25): totals +7.6% CLV (114 bets, pass), moneylines +4.4% (30), spreads +2.1% (40). Mirrors the NFL A+ tracks. Pass: >= 100 bets, CLV > 0 at p < 0.01, ROI > 0. Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.
